title: Insert or Erase
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1 \leq N \leq 2\times 10^5; 1 \leq Q \leq 2\times 10^5; 1 \leq A_i \leq 10^9; A_i \neq A_j; For queries of the first type, 1 \leq x,y \leq 10^9.; When a query of the first type is given, x exists in A.; For queries of the second type, 1 \leq x \leq 10^9.; When a query of the second type is given, x exists in A.; After processing each query, A is not empty, and its elements are distinct.; All input values are integers.
